protocol.order: off/on then on/off in alternating rounds; one persistent device
protocol.input: Identical RGB-derived keypoints/matches shared by both modes; no truth poses/depth/masks/identity correspondences enter inference
protocol.frontend: Decode, features, upload, matching, readback and descriptor disposal measured once per case. Composed pipeline time adds that same measured frontend to each mapper run.
protocol.limits: No raw-video codec, native GPU, GS/MVS or real gameplay benchmark. Six warm samples are not a statistical performance guarantee. Epipolar-graph inspection is separate from timings.
protocol.calibration: Synthetic cases use supplied known K. Pexels pyramid uses assumed 0.8*width K and has no ground-truth camera/depth accuracy claim.
protocol.memory: Managed device allocation peaks include the reusable pool; active peaks subtract pooled bytes. Both exclude driver, decoded pixels and host graph memory. Released pooled buffers are not leaks; active bytes must return to zero after every mapping run.
